summary: This note is the source code of the DetachableJoint system plugin for Gazebo (gz-sim), copyright 2019 Open Source Robotics Foundation under the Apache License 2.0. The plugin attaches a child link of a child model to a parent link by creating a fixed joint entity when an attach request arrives, and removes that joint when a detach request arrives. It reads required SDF parameters parent_link, child_model and child_link, configures detach, attach and output topics, and publishes the state strings "attached" or "detached" on the output topic.
one_line: Gazebo DetachableJoint plugin source that attaches and detaches a child model link to a parent link via topic-driven fixed joints.
key_facts: The DetachableJoint plugin is copyright (C) 2019 Open Source Robotics Foundation and licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
Configure requires the SDF element parent_link, which must name a link in the model; otherwise initialization fails with an error.
Configure requires the SDF elements child_model and child_link; missing either causes initialization to fail.
If no detach_topic is given, the default detach topic is /model/<model name>/detachable_joint/detach.
If no attach_topic is given, the default attach topic is /model/<model name>/detachable_joint/attach.
If no output_topic is given, the default output topic is /model/<child model name>/detachable_joint/state.
If both <topic> and <detach_topic> are present with different contents, an error is printed asking the user to verify the tags and use <detach_topic>.
The attach request callback ignores the request and logs "Already attached" when the joint is already attached; otherwise it sets attachRequested to true.
In PreUpdate, the child model is looked up by name, or uses the plugin's own model when child_model is "__model__".
When the child link is found, PreUpdate creates a new entity holding a components::DetachableJoint with the parent link, child link and joint type "fixed".
A child model that is not found produces a warning unless the suppress_child_warning parameter is set to true.
On detach, PreUpdate calls RequestRemoveEntity on the detachable joint entity, sets isAttached to false and publishes the state.
OnDetachRequest logs "Already detached" and returns when the joint is not attached; otherwise it sets detachRequested to true.
The state is published as a gz::msgs::StringMsg with data "attached" or "detached".
The plugin is registered with GZ_ADD_PLUGIN and aliased as gz::sim::systems::DetachableJoint and, as deprecated, ignition::gazebo::systems::DetachableJoint, to be removed in version 8.
